description: Is this document still current, or superseded by a newer one? — Given the target document id, the supplied set of documents (id, effective date, which ids each one supersedes, withdrawn flag) and a reference date, reports whether the target is superseded or withdrawn as of that date, following supersession chains, and names the superseding document and its date. For an agent about to rely on a standard, price list, policy or datasheet revision. It can only see

asOf.description: Reference date: a superseding document counts only if effective on or before it.

documents.description: The documents the caller knows of, including the target.

listComplete.description: The caller asserts documents holds every document that could supersede the target. Required for a pass.

target.description: Id of the document being relied on.

name: document-supersession
